ruling.recommended_action: Refund the S$6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no driver account action for this cancellation.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's statement that he was on his way conflicts with gps/timeline records [F1][F3][F4] showing he never came within 200 m and never tapped I'm Here; system records prevail over statements.
Ryde publishes no rule that driver lateness past ETA waives the cancellation fee; NS-8 is informational and 不可引用.
Band 3 (20–29 km/h) with no recorded incidents [F11] does not explain a 2.2 km gap and is not a ground to charge the rider under NS-4.
